channel.title: STADA - Press Releases
channel.description: Últimos comunicados de prensa publicados por STADA

item.title: STADA appoints Diana Wiedmann as Chief Culture & People Officer
item.description: STADA has appointed Diana Wiedmann as Chief Culture & People Officer (CPO), effective 1 January 2027

item.title: STADA Health Report 2026: 82 percent of Europeans are open to AI playing a role in their healthcare
item.description: STADA Health Report 2026: 82 percent of Europeans are open to AI playing a role in their healthcare

item.title: STADA welcomes former Reckitt executive Mark Pearson as Global Head Consumer Healthcare
item.description: STADA has from 1 July welcomed former Reckitt executive Mark Pearson as Head and Executive Vice-President (EVP), Global Consumer Healthcare

item.title: STADA acquires significant Consumer Healthcare portfolio from Orifarm for further growth acceleration
item.description: STADA is further strengthening its Consumer Healthcare offering through European pharmacies

item.title: STADA strengthens as a leader in consumer healthcare in Europe by acquiring Locobase derma line in Nordics
item.description: STADA has reinforced its status as a partner of choice and top player in European consumer healthcare.

item.title: Enzymatica and STADA sign partnership agreement for Germany and Austria
item.description: Enzymatica and STADA have entered into a partnership agreement regarding the launch and distribution of Enzymatica’s ColdZyme® oral-spray technology in Germany and Austria

item.title: CapVest Completes Majority Acquisition of STADA
item.description: CapVest today announces the completion of its acquisition of the majority stake in STADA

item.title: STADA strikes deal with CuraTeQ for neutropenia biosimilars in Europe
item.description: STADA has entered into a marketing and distribution agreement with CuraTeQ focused on biosimilars, to bring to market two neutropenia biosimilars in Europe

item.title: STADA’s Strong Growth Journey Continues in 2025
item.description: STADA in 2025 again demonstrated the success of its three-segment strategy, that provides patients and healthcare professionals with a broad range of medicines and healthcare products

item.title: STADA invests more than €85m in Saudi Arabia manufacturing hub
item.description: Global healthcare company STADA today committed to investing more than €85 million in a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Saudi Arabia

item.title: STADA and Bio-Thera receive European Marketing Authorization for Gotenfia, a Biosimilar to Simponi
item.description: STADA and Bio-Thera Solutions have received a marketing authorization from the European Commission

item.title: STADA’s Head of Communications Frank Staud additionally leads Global Government Affairs
item.description: Effective 1 January 2026, STADA's global Head of Communications Frank Staud (56) is additionally assuming global responsibility for STADA’s Global Government Affairs
